query_description: For single games, from 2018 to 2024, started the game, played QB, in the regular season or the postseason, sorted by descending Date.
raw_row_semantics: candidate rows returned by Stathead query; not automatically accepted actual-QB starters
holdout_rule: Do not inspect or use 2025 NFL-season outcomes/starter data. Jan/Feb 2025 games belonging to the 2024 postseason are development rows, not holdout rows.
raw_preservation_rules: Preserve literal Stathead rows and anomalies.
Do not silently repair or normalize raw files in place.
Do not infer actual starter from attempts, yards, snaps, fantasy stats, result, or other target-game statistics.
Write cleaned/reconciled outputs to new versioned files.
Do not alter existing frozen historical game files.
recovery_method: manual Stathead CSV copy/paste from subscriber UI into ChatGPT conversation, then durable repository recovery
recovery_note: Conversation summaries prove that ranks 1-3921 were manually acquired, but a row is marked durable only after its literal CSV text is committed. Hidden/skipped chat turns are not reconstructed from summaries. Ranks 2201-3400 still require literal recovery before the raw archive is complete.

downstream_cleaning_contract.identity_mapping: PFR ID -> nflverse player crosswalk -> canonical GSIS ID
